scope: Offline host gesture implementation/tests only; no hardware, firmware installation or frozen-input modifications.

policy.timing: Use actual monotonic milliseconds, raw onset of final debounced level, uint32 modulo arithmetic
policy.cancellation: Other key, long hold, expired gap cancel partial sequence; require quiet debounced release after combination/hold/initialization/toggle
policy.retoggle: Three fresh short taps required; repeated release and bounce cannot duplicate toggle. No additional fixed cooldown.

result: All host scenarios passed, exit0; ASan and UBSan reported no issue.

target_limit: This is deterministic offline logic validation. Device-side MMIO access, scheduling, callback ownership and hot-switching are not hardware-verified by these tests.
